    AVG(Enrollment (K-12) - Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) AS avg_diff

  WHERE FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  GROUP BY CDSCode
),

  SELECT 
    s1.CDSCode, 
    s1.DOCType, 
    s1.SchoolName
